_comment: Config generator registry. One entry per config SCHEMA — not per plugin release. 'since' is the first plugin build that ships that schema and may be a nightly (e.g. 2.3.0-BETA.1) when a schema debuts in one. INVARIANT: the newest entry here must match the schema declared in src/main/resources/config.yml's trailer — a schema listed here that the plugin isn't shipping yet will capture newer releases and send them to a generator that doesn't exist. scripts/validate-config-generator.py enforces this. BETA status and the plugin-version list are derived from the GitHub releases API at runtime, so new plugin releases need NO changes here. Set 'generatorReady': false only for the CURRENT schema while its bundle is still being built. A new schema = add one entry + a new self-contained docs/assets/configs/v<N>/ folder. NEVER edit an older schema's folder after a newer one ships.
